Cherry Martini
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 2:14pm

Ingredients




2 ounces Russian Vodka
ounce Kirsch
ounce Cherry Brandy
1 ounce sour cherry juice

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients in a shaker filled wiith ice, cover, and shake like mad until frost forms on the outside of the shaker. 2 Strain into a large martini glass and daintily drop a fresh Bing cherry into the frosty pool of delight for garnish.
